gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed patients with histopathological diagnosis of WHO grade IV glioma (GBM).

candidate_evidence.quote: ITI-1001 DNA vaccine represents a multi-antigen nucleic acid cancer immunotherapy encoding 3 CMV antigens.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed patients with histopathological diagnosis of WHO grade IV glioma (GBM).

role_evidence.quote: ITI-1001 DNA vaccine represents a multi-antigen nucleic acid cancer immunotherapy encoding 3 CMV antigens.

agents.drug_class_hint: DNA plasmid vaccine encoding CMV pp65, IE-1 and gB antigens with LAMP1 (IM electroporation)

role_evidence.quote: ITI-1001 vaccinations will be given in combination with Td toxoid.

agents.drug_class_hint: tetanus-diphtheria toxoid vaccine given with the DNA vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Planned standard adjuvant chemoradiation (SOC RT + TMZ for 6 weeks).

biomarkers.biomarker_other: CMV antigens pp65, IE1, gB in tumour (IHC)

source_quote.quote: IHC detects cytomegalovirus (CMV) proteins pp65, IE1, and Glycoprotein B (gB) in human glioblastoma multiforme tissues

coder_notes: DNA vaccine is an excluded intervention type, so no candidate. Td toxoid is co-administered with every vaccination and listed as a vaccine-type agent. Immune-response endpoints relate to the vaccine, which is not a candidate, so target_engagement_planned is coded no.
